_comment: cg26v: cg26u + the context diagnostic and InfoNCE on the generic arm. Keys starting with _ are ignored by scripts/merge_overrides.py.
_inf_jx: train the index each sleep and print the JEPA INDEX readouts; readouts only, the trunk is not trained
_inf_jx_dim: encoder width and depth (about 3M parameters); local runs use 128 x 3
_inf_jx_nce: 0 = pure V-JEPA (EMA target, L1, no negatives); > 0 adds InfoNCE over the batch (the toy: helps when facts share a subject)
_inf_jx_pool: the most recent live stored sentences that are keyed
_inf_jx_arm_nce: arm C: a second encoder trained with this InfoNCE weight added to the L1 (local end of run top-1 0.85 against 0.76 for arm V)
_inf_jx_gen: arm G, the generic trace: names found by the store's own name finder are masked before encoding and kept as slots; retrieval among the sentences whose slots hold the question's name, ranked by the name-free key (local HYBRID 1.00)
_inf_jx_pair: paired-wording training stays off: locally it did not raise held-out retrieval (0.12 with it against 0.15 without)
_inf_jx_route: JEPA ROUTING readout: each visit's stored sentences in 1 KB windows routed by bytes, by JEPA codes and by both, at 1 and 4 windows; routing itself unchanged
_cd_klclass: REPLAY SIGNAL BY BYTE CLASS readout: every 25th conduit call, share of the teacher KL and byte loss on space/punctuation, digits, function words, names and other words
_inf_jx_gen_nce: InfoNCE weight on arm G (the generic trace): on the GPU the L1-only arms collapsed in the first sleeps (key spread 0.17-0.24) before recovering
_inf_jx_ctxdiag: CONTEXT DIAGNOSTIC line: one-hop picks by summed and by mean byte log-probability, the planted fact sentence in context, whether the stored true sentence holds the fact, share of wrong picks that are shorter names, two examples
_pinned_12nov: old defaults pinned when distillation, mlp_out writes and the capacity pool became defaults (11 Nov), so this preset reproduces its run
_pinned_rule_world: rule world (on by default from 11 Nov evening) pinned off so this preset reproduces its run
